title: ProviderAdapter
description: Contract for model provider adapters. Real providers and ScriptedTestProvider must implement this interface.

normalize_request.description: Transforms internal request to provider-specific format

parse_response.description: Parses provider response into internal ParsedResponse

normalize_tool_call.description: Normalizes tool call format across providers

map_error.description: Maps provider errors to internal error taxonomy

validate_data_policy.description: Validates request against data policy (region, retention)

fallback_compatibility_checker.description: Checks if fallback provider is compatible
